workProduct.subject: Status update on your enrollment and next step
workProduct.body:
Hello Taylor,

Thanks — we received your enrollment and have recorded the prescription intake with the pharmacy. One small item is still needed: the consent form is missing the required signature. Please complete and sign the consent through the same secure program channel you used for enrollment so the pharmacy can finish its administrative checks.

Once the pharmacy confirms receipt and completes its checks, they will be able to move the case toward dispensing. Right now, no dispense release or shipment confirmation has been recorded, so we can’t provide a delivery date.

If you have clinical or medication questions, please ask your clinician or the pharmacy pharmacist. If you need help completing the consent in the secure channel, reply to this message and I’ll guide you on next steps.

Best,
Jordan Rivera
Willow Support
